feed.summary: Applied Materials has introduced three new chipmaking systems designed to enhance the performance of Gate-All-Around (GAA) transistors and wiring for 2nm and beyond logic chips, crucial for faster and more energy-efficient AI. These technologies aim to overcome scaling challenges and accelerate the development of next-generation AI chips.
